title: The Seed of God’s Word
verse: Now the parable means this: The seed is the word of God.
observation: I love how Jesus describes the Word of God in this parable. He calls it the seed. In the parable, it was the seed that had different impacts on the soil it was placed in. However, this is something we tend to frequently overlook. The seed had an impact in every type of soil. One of the greatest pleasures we experience is to hear the powerful Word of God. We also know that we never leave unchanged when we slow down and truly hear what God’s Word says.
application: Spend time reflecting on God’s Word.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for Your powerful, life-changing Word.
